args.title: Document S3_ENDPOINT requirement for MinIO in README
args.body:
File: README.md

In the 'Running locally' section (step 2 or 3), add a line noting that when using MinIO (or any non-AWS S3-compatible store) you must set S3_ENDPOINT (e.g. http://localhost:9000) and create the bucket beforehand. Without this, uploads default to AWS and fail with ENOTFOUND.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The 'Running locally' section only mentions using a MinIO container for the bucket but omits that S3_ENDPOINT must be set, which causes uploads to default to AWS and fail with ENOTFOUND; adding this detail to step 2 or 3 should resolve the confusion.
